notes: Federal filings plus the tax return and tax at source of the company's canton. Cantons set their own tax return dates, so those are left for staff to confirm.

items.name: Annual General Meeting — Approval of the Annual Accounts
items.rule: Within 6 months after financial year end
items.applies: AG and GmbH
items.description: Approves the accounts and the dividend; accounts are not filed publicly.
items.authority: Swiss Code of Obligations art. 699 and 805

items.name: Share Register and List of Beneficial Owners
items.rule: Keep current; shareholders report beneficial owners within 1 month of acquiring 25%
items.applies: AG and GmbH
items.description: The company keeps both registers and must be able to produce them in Switzerland.
items.authority: Swiss Code of Obligations art. 697j and 790a

items.name: Withholding Tax on Dividends (Form 103 / 110)
items.rule: Within 30 days after the dividend falls due
items.applies: AG and GmbH
items.description: 35% withholding tax is declared and paid, or the notification procedure is used within a group.

items.name: VAT Return (quarterly)
items.rule: Within 60 days after each quarter: end of May, August, November and February
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses using the effective method
items.description: Filed online through ePortal with payment.

items.name: VAT Return (half-yearly)
items.rule: Within 60 days after each half-year: end of August and end of February
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses using the net tax rate method
items.description: Filed online through ePortal with payment.

items.name: VAT Return (monthly)
items.rule: Within 60 days after each month
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses with regular input tax surpluses that chose monthly returns
items.description: Filed online through ePortal.

items.name: VAT Return (annual) with Instalments
items.rule: Within 60 days after the year end; instalments during the year
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses with turnover up to CHF 5.005 million that chose annual returns
items.description: Filed online through ePortal.

items.name: VAT Annual Reconciliation (corrections to the year's returns)
items.rule: Within 180 days after financial year end
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses
items.description: Returns are reconciled to the annual accounts and any differences reported in a correction return.

items.name: VAT Registration
items.rule: When worldwide turnover from taxable supplies reaches CHF 100,000 in a year
items.applies: Businesses not yet VAT-registered
items.description: Registered online with the Federal Tax Administration.

items.name: Annual Salary Declaration to the Compensation Office (AHV/IV/EO/ALV)
items.rule: 30 January
items.applies: Employers
items.description: The year's wages per employee, used to settle the contributions paid on account.

items.name: Social Insurance Contributions on Account (AHV/IV/EO/ALV)
items.rule: 10th day after each period (monthly, or quarterly for small payrolls)
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Employer and employee contributions are paid on account to the compensation office.

items.name: Salary Certificates, Accident Insurance and Pension Fund Wage Declarations
items.rule: End of January
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Each employee receives a salary certificate (some cantons also want a copy); the accident insurer and pension fund receive the year's wages.
items.authority: Accident insurer (Suva or private) / pension fund / cantonal tax administration

items.name: Transfer Pricing Support and Country-by-Country Reporting
items.rule: On the tax administration's request; group notifications with the tax return
items.applies: Companies with cross-border related-party transactions
items.description: Switzerland has no fixed documentation deadline, but prices must be shown to be at arm's length.

items.name: Corporate Tax Return — Canton of Aargau (cantonal, communal and direct federal tax)
items.rule: On the date printed on the canton's tax return form; extensions are granted on request
items.applies: Companies and branches taxed in Aargau
items.description: One return to the canton covers its own profit and capital taxes, the commune's and the direct federal tax. Each canton sets its own filing date.

items.name: Personal Tax Return — Canton of Aargau
items.rule: On the date printed on the canton's tax return form (the end of March in most cantons); extensions are granted on request
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partners resident in Aargau
items.description: Business income is declared in the owner's personal return, with the annual accounts attached.

employerItems.name: Tax at Source on Foreign Employees' Wages (Quellensteuer) — Aargau
employerItems.rule: Within 30 days after each accounting period (monthly in most cantons)
employerItems.applies: Employers of foreign staff without a C permit, and cross-border workers, taxed in Aargau
employerItems.description: Tax is deducted from wages and paid to the canton entitled to it, at that canton's rates.

employerItems.applies: Employers of foreign staff without a C permit, and cross-border workers, taxed in Valais
employerItems.description: Tax is deducted from wages and paid to the canton entitled to it, at that canton's rates.

items.name: Corporate Tax Return — Canton of Vaud (cantonal, communal and direct federal tax)
items.rule: On the date printed on the canton's tax return form; extensions are granted on request
items.applies: Companies and branches taxed in Vaud
items.description: One return to the canton covers its own profit and capital taxes, the commune's and the direct federal tax. Each canton sets its own filing date.

items.name: Personal Tax Return — Canton of Vaud
items.rule: On the date printed on the canton's tax return form (the end of March in most cantons); extensions are granted on request
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partners resident in Vaud
items.description: Business income is declared in the owner's personal return, with the annual accounts attached.
